shortdesc.ph: Starts an audio device loopback test.
Starts an audio device loopback test.

section.p: This method tests whether the local audio capture and playback devices work properly. After you call this method, the audio capture device captures local audio and the audio playback device plays the captured audio.

ul.li: You can call this method either before or after joining a channel.
This method only takes effect when called by the host.
This method tests only local audio devices and does not report network conditions.
After the test is complete, call to stop the audio device loopback test.

plentry.pd: The interval, in milliseconds, at which the SDK triggers the audio volume indication callback. Agora recommends setting this value to greater than 200 ms.
